sentences.6.3 Hva gjorde du i fritida i hjemlandet: 6.3 What did you do in your free time in your home country?
sentences.I fritida var jeg ofte ute og danset med: In my free time I was often out dancing with friends, or we went to concerts. I also played volleyball, and sometimes I went shopping with my girlfriends.
sentences.I Polen trente jeg på treningssenter tre: In Poland I trained at a gym three times a week with friends. We also used to go to football matches. Now I only watch football on TV, and I always train alone.
I often invited friends to my home. I lived in a big city, and we used to go to discos at the weekends.
sentences.Jeg laget ofte mat i hjemlandet. Mamma l: I often cooked in my home country. My mum taught me a lot. I liked cooking with her. I spent a lot of time with my girlfriends, and we chatted and sang. Now and then we went to parties and danced.
I didn't have much free time in my home country. I worked almost all the time, but now and then I played cards with friends. At the weekends we used to go on picnics with the children.
sentences.Jeg spilte ofte fotball med venner i hje: I often played football with friends in my home country. We also used to go to the cinema. Sometimes we went to the sea and had a nice time on the beach.
sentences.Hva gjorde de i fritida?: What did they do in their free time?
The girl went on a fishing trip.
The family went on a picnic.
